name: Alistair Davies
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport analytics began unconventionally, with a background in theoretical physics. After completing his doctorate, he felt a pull towards more practical applications of his analytical skills. He found the perfect intersection in the complex world of motorsport, where data reigns supreme. He started with smaller teams, honing his ability to extract meaningful insights from raw telemetry data. 

He is highly valued for his aptitude to identify correlations that others miss. His approach is rooted in a deep understanding of the underlying physics of racing, combined with a relentless pursuit of data-driven improvements. He is known for his comprehensive reports and his ability to communicate complicated concepts in a way that engineers and drivers can understand. His calm demeanor under pressure makes him a valuable asset during high-stakes races.

Alistair distinguishes himself through his focus on long-term trends. He is not just interested in the immediate gains from a single race, but in identifying patterns that can lead to sustained competitive advantage for the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Alistair is of average height with a slightly wiry build, and his glasses often sit slightly askew.

quirks: Always carries a well-worn copy of 'Feynman Lectures on Physics'.
Insists on using a mechanical keyboard for optimal tactile feedback.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
